steps.heading: Welcome to Access AI
steps.visible: This setup can be completed without sight. Access AI will ask how you want to use the app.
steps.speech: Welcome to Access AI. This setup can be completed without sight. I am going to start the assisted setup now. You can stop Access AI speech at any time, and your screen reader will continue to work normally.

steps.heading: Choose spoken guidance
steps.visible: Choose whether Access AI should continue speaking setup instructions. Your screen reader remains available either way.
steps.speech: Choose whether you want Access AI to continue speaking setup instructions. Select Continue Access AI spoken guidance, or Use screen reader only. Then activate Continue.

steps.heading: 1 of 3 — Vision
steps.visible: Choose the vision option that best matches how you want Access AI to assist you.
steps.speech: Step one. Vision. Choose the option that best matches how you want Access AI to assist you. Then activate Continue.

steps.heading: 2 of 3 — Interaction
steps.speech: Step two. Interaction. Choose voice first, screen reader and keyboard, refreshable Braille display, large text, or combination. Then activate Continue.

steps.heading: 3 of 3 — Device and answers
steps.visible: Choose your device, spoken-answer preference, and answer style.
steps.speech: Final step. Choose your device or screen reader, whether answers should be spoken automatically, and your preferred answer style. Then activate Finish setup and open Access AI.
